newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.
Vessels: no data available due to a change in computer software at the port.
Road: 591 trucks carrying sugar arrived between Aug 1 and 3. Loading: no figures available.
Vessels: Icarus, Seanav I, Global Star and Libanus each loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Mattz Spica loading 12,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Delta Freedom loading 13,125 tonnes sugar.

Valentin Khutorsk loading 12,500 tonnes bagged sugar. APJ Angad loading 22,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, two vessels to load bulk sugar and four to load sugar (unspecified). No vessels docked at Cargill private terminal. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load bulk sugar and two to load sugar (unspecified).
Stocks: 9,424 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable.
